name: Gear Potentiometer out of Bounds
hint: A gear potentiometer comparison outside 0–100 refers to a value the sensor cannot produce, so position-based behaviour becomes unreliable.
instruction: Validate potentiometer readings and thresholds as integers from 0 through 100 before using them.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB gear potentiometer value :: sensing) > (150)> then
say [Invalid gear value]
end
